photo_reel.scope: stills-cut Reels only (a cut sequence of photoreal STILLS composed in accounts/nuvarel/reels/<id>/reel.html and rendered by scripts/render_reel.py). Photoreal VIDEO generation is still unproven and still closed. Demonstration-type Reels (a physical outcome shown happening) stay closed per condition (3) below unless filmed for real or reframed so the copy illustrates rather than records.
photo_reel.note: Opened 2026-09-07 on the file's own condition (2): the stills-to-Reel build path now exists and one Quick Games Reel passed a frame-level review -- `2026-09-07-which-leather-is-real` (reel-game, 15.6 s, two photographs on one seed 90807, guess -> countdown -> reveal -> tells -> save; 33 sampled frames + full-size key frames reviewed by Group CTO, plus a second pass after a transition fix; founder review still pending, needs_review true). Why that piece clears condition (3): nothing in it is depicted HAPPENING -- both swatches are static object studies with no claimed physical event or outcome, the copy says 'illustrated here so you know what to look for', and the container carries is_ai_generated. The same reasoning was applied to the second piece built the same night, `2026-09-08-turn-it-over` (reel-reveal: an upright bowl cut to a low close view of the same bowl on its bare foot; a second static view, not footage of a bowl being turned -- rebuilt 2026-09-07 after the first cut's tipped-pot frame failed a 1:1 crop check on the foot: the WAN 1.3B model invents a saucer or loose ring for any inverted-vessel foot prompt, 18/18 candidates). Condition (1) satisfied 2026-09-05 (Group Legal). Per-piece rule going forward: any Reel whose premise is 'watch X happen' (cushion recovering, board sanded, water beading) is NOT covered by this open state -- film it or reframe it first.

history.closed_2026-09-05_note: Any Reel whose visuals are AI-generated photoreal imagery (video OR a cut sequence of stills) stays closed until ALL THREE: (1) [SATISFIED 2026-09-05, Group Legal -- income-engine docs/consults/2026-09-05-group-legal-nuvarel-ai-disclosure-read.md] Meta's `is_ai_generated=true` container parameter (wired in scripts/publish_due_posts.py, opt-in via queue JSON `ai_generated: true`) satisfies the Misinformation-standard disclosure duty on AI photoreal video -- confirmed, nothing else needs to accompany it. (2) [OPEN] a stills-to-Reel build path exists and one Quick Games Reel has passed a frame-level review. Photoreal VIDEO generation itself is separately unproven (~2h GPU/clip). (3) [OPEN, new 2026-09-05, Group Legal -- standing-note P26] disclosure alone does not clear a Reel that DEMONSTRATES a physical outcome (a cushion recovering, a board revealing grain) -- generated footage of a physical event is a fabricated evidentiary claim on an account whose positioning is 'the proof, not the claim,' independent of the legal disclosure question. Per-piece requirement once (1)+(2) are met: any demonstration-type Reel must be either genuinely filmed, or reframed so the generated imagery illustrates rather than claims to record an event (caption language must not assert the depicted event occurred). Object/material-study Reels (no claimed physical outcome) are not subject to this condition.

illustrated_reel.note: This lane did not exist in this file before today, which is the real mechanical gap the 2026-09-13 ruling left open: photo_reel covers only the photoreal register, so an illustrated Reel had no open lane to be built under even after the ruling reinstated the character. Demonstration-type pieces ('watch X happen') ARE permitted in this lane, which is the one substantive difference from photo_reel. Reason, and it is the same escape hatch Group Legal named on 2026-09-05 (portfolio standing-note P26): the objection to a generated demonstration is that it PURPORTS TO EVIDENCE a physical outcome on an account whose promise is 'the proof, not the claim'. A flat drawn diagram cannot purport to evidence anything -- it manifestly ILLUSTRATES the claim, and no viewer mistakes it for footage. Per-piece requirement kept anyway, because the caption can still overreach where the picture does not: caption and on-screen copy must be written as illustration and instruction ('illustrated here so you know what to look for', 'press it yourself'), never as a report of a specific event that occurred ('watch this cushion recover'). First piece: 2026-09-13-the-press-test (reel-satisfying, 17.5s, two Curators, cushion A/B press with a bronze datum line and a measured residual). ai_generated stays false on this lane by construction -- nothing in it is AI-generated -- which is independent of the founder's 2026-09-12 blanket suspension of that flag (CLAUDE.md hard rule 5). Quality floor: scripts/frame_gate.py --profile nuvarel runs on the --qa-dir output, same as every other lane.
